scope.excluded: Unselected fourth column and later rows; no polling for them.

method: Read current local map and its QA notes, reviewed selected v02/v01 sources only, then generated 1:1 actual-v05 top/core-below shared-edge crops. Did not repeat whole-art source provenance validation.

findings.description: A newly painted flower cluster conflicts with the existing above-tile pavement: flower tops terminate on the exact y=36864 tile boundary. The carried-over cluster and stone texture also terminate at an exact vertical x=10355 edge in the third core, creating a rectangular pasted region. This is a real object/geometry clipping defect, not just a tone mismatch.
findings.recommendation: Root is handling this crossing. Remove the unsupported flower strip and restore continuous stone pavement against the actual above tile; preserve legitimate stone joints and small joint weeds. Do not extend the clipped flower cluster as a workaround.
findings.handoff: Sent exact coordinates and evidence to /root and /root/lower_patch_resume; lower worker told not to duplicate root's repair.

findings.description: The invented lower wall frame is gone in selected v02. However, at y=36864 the foreground package leaf brightness/strokes change abruptly and the rope texture/border transition is conspicuous. The broad package silhouette remains plausible; the horizontal material and local contour join should not be described as fully seamless.
findings.recommendation: Use a same-coordinate crossing repair if the top row is being finalized; preserve the already-approved package silhouette and rope placement. This is lower priority than the flower rectangle, but remains visible at native scale.

passes.result: No invented extra frame seen; do not reject it for the superseded v01 frame defect.

passes.area: s01_02 post, stone foot and wall skirting
passes.result: Main contours cross the shared border continuously; no new large wooden/stone structure observed.

passes.area: s01_03 gold/red column base and stair edge
passes.result: Column-base and stair contours remain connected across the shared edge outside the flower rectangle.

limitations: No claim of final tile or row acceptance.
Review restricted to three selected first-row cores at the map snapshot; fourth core was unselected.
No game/runtime tests or image generation performed.
